title: 实验 3-5 · 呼吸灯：电容让 LED 慢慢亮、慢慢暗
summary: 0.5 Hz 方波经二极管给 1000 µF 电容充电，电容再通过 470 Ω 给 LED 供电：充电快、放电慢，LED 像呼吸一样一明一暗。
concepts: 充电与放电时间常数不同 different charge / discharge τ
二极管单向导电 diode blocks back-flow
description: **要搭的电路**：信号发生器红夹子 → 二极管 D1（正极朝信号发生器）→ R1（220 Ω）→ 结点 VC。VC 上接 C1（1000 µF，到 GND），同时接 R2（470 Ω）→ 红色 LED → GND。黑夹子接 GND。
**信号发生器**：方波，幅度 4.5 V、偏置 4.5 V（0 ↔ 9 V），频率 0.5 Hz（周期 2 s，慢到眼睛能看清）。
**示波器**：CH1 接 VC，CH2 接 LED 正极。R2 上的电压 VC − V(LED+) 除以 470 Ω 就是 LED 电流。时基调到 500 ms/格左右。
**为什么会“呼吸”**：
- **高电平（9 V）1 s**：电流经 D1、R1 给电容充电，同时点亮 LED。充电时间常数看 VC 结点的戴维宁电阻：τ充 ≈ C × [(R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ (R2 + 12 Ω)] ≈ 1000 µF × 173 Ω ≈ 0.17 s，所以 LED 很快亮起来。
- **低电平（0 V）1 s**：D1 反偏截止，电容不能倒灌回信号发生器，只能经 R2 和 LED 慢慢放电：LED 电流 ≈ (VC − 1.8 V)/(470 + 12 Ω)，按 τ放 ≈ 1000 µF × 482 Ω ≈ 0.48 s 指数减小——LED 慢慢变暗。
- 稳态下 VC 在约 2.3 V 和 6.0 V 之间来回；LED 电流在约 1.1 mA 和 8.7 mA 之间起伏（R2 上电压约 0.5 V ~ 4.1 V），从不完全熄灭，所以看起来是“呼吸”而不是“闪烁”。
**二极管的作用**：如果把 D1 换成导线，低电平时电容会经 R1 快速放电回信号发生器（τ 只有约 0.17 s），VC 掉到 0.1 V 左右，LED 有一半时间完全熄灭——变成普通的慢闪。二极管让充电和放电走不同的路径，于是有了两个不同的时间常数。
**把频率调到 20 Hz**：半周期 25 ms 远小于两个时间常数，电容来不及充放，VC 几乎是一条直线（≈ 4.9 V，纹波约 0.16 Vpp），LED 稳定地亮着（≈ 6.4 mA）。这就是“电容滤波”：后面学到的整流滤波电路正是这个原理。
注：示波器的“亮 / 灭”判断按平均电流（人眼对快速闪烁取平均）。1000 µF 一般是电解电容，有极性：长脚（+）接 VC，短脚接 GND。

en.title: Experiment 3-5 · Breathing LED: a capacitor makes the LED fade in and out
en.summary: A 0.5 Hz square wave charges a 1000 µF capacitor through a diode; the capacitor feeds an LED through 470 Ω. Fast charge, slow discharge: the LED "breathes".
description: **What you build**: generator red clip → diode D1 (anode toward the generator) → R1 (220 Ω) → node VC. From VC, C1 (1000 µF) goes to GND, and R2 (470 Ω) → red LED → GND. Black clip to GND.
**Generator**: square wave, amplitude 4.5 V, offset 4.5 V (0 ↔ 9 V), 0.5 Hz (2 s period, slow enough to follow by eye).
**Scope**: CH1 on VC, CH2 on the LED anode. The voltage across R2, VC − V(LED+), divided by 470 Ω is the LED current. Set the time base to about 500 ms/div.
**Why it "breathes"**:

- **High (9 V) for 1 s**: current flows through D1 and R1, charging the capacitor and lighting the LED. The charging time constant uses the Thévenin resistance seen from VC: τ_charge ≈ C × [(R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ (R2 + 12 Ω)] ≈ 1000 µF × 173 Ω ≈ 0.17 s, so the LED brightens quickly.

- **Low (0 V) for 1 s**: D1 is reverse-biased, so the capacitor cannot flow back into the generator; it can only discharge slowly through R2 and the LED: LED current ≈ (VC − 1.8 V)/(470 + 12 Ω), decaying with τ_discharge ≈ 1000 µF × 482 Ω ≈ 0.48 s — the LED dims slowly.

- In steady state VC swings between about 2.3 V and 6.0 V; the LED current rises and falls between about 1.1 mA and 8.7 mA (about 0.5 V to 4.1 V across R2). It never goes fully dark, so it looks like breathing rather than blinking.

**What the diode does**: replace D1 with a wire and, while the generator is low, the capacitor quickly discharges back into the generator through R1 (τ only about 0.17 s); VC drops to about 0.1 V and the LED is completely off half the time — an ordinary slow blink. The diode sends charge and discharge along different paths, hence two different time constants.

**Turn the frequency up to 20 Hz**: a 25 ms half period is far shorter than both time constants, so the capacitor has no time to charge or discharge much: VC is almost flat (≈ 4.9 V with ≈ 0.16 Vpp ripple) and the LED glows steadily (≈ 6.4 mA). That's capacitor smoothing — exactly the principle of the rectifier filters you'll meet later.
Note: the LED's on/off is judged by its average current (the eye averages fast blinking). A 1000 µF capacitor is usually electrolytic and polarised: long lead (+) to VC, short lead to GND.
hints: Diode anode (no stripe) toward the generator, cathode (striped end) toward R1.
The capacitor and the R2 + LED branch both hang from the same node VC.
Charging goes through the diode; discharging can only go through R2 and the LED.
tests: 0.5 Hz: the LED breathes — about 1.1 mA to 8.7 mA, never fully off
0.5 Hz: VC swings between ≈ 2.3 V and ≈ 6.0 V
20 Hz: the capacitor smooths it out — VC ripple < 0.2 Vpp, steady ≈ 6.4 mA

tests.name: 0.5 Hz：LED 呼吸——电流约 1.1 mA ~ 8.7 mA，从不完全熄灭
0.5 Hz：VC 在 ≈ 2.3 V 和 ≈ 6.0 V 之间
20 Hz：电容滤平——VC 纹波 < 0.2 Vpp，LED 稳定 ≈ 6.4 mA

hints: 二极管正极（没有色环的一端）朝信号发生器，负极（有色环）朝 R1。
电容和“R2 + LED”这条支路都挂在同一个结点 VC 上。
充电走二极管；放电只能走 R2 和 LED。
